Welcome to the ProjectPulse AI governance framework. This document provides the entry point to our governance practices, processes, and documentation.

## The 4 Core Principles

### I. AI-Driven Financial Intelligence
Every financial insight must leverage AI analysis. Insights must be transparent, validated, auditable, and configurable.

### II. Financial Data Integrity & Compliance
All financial data must maintain accuracy, traceability, and regulatory compliance through single source of truth, audit trails, precision standards, reconciliation checks, and data validation.

### III. Scalable API-First Architecture
The backend must be a clean, stateless service with well-defined contracts, modular design, and database integrity.

### IV. Test-Driven Development & Quality Gates
All code must follow strict testing discipline with 80% minimum coverage, integration tests, database tests, and manual review gates.

## Getting Started

1. **Read the Constitution**: Start with [.specify/memory/constitution.md](../.specify/memory/constitution.md) to understand the 4 core principles
2. **Review Your Role**: Check [docs/governance/developer-onboarding.md](../docs/governance/developer-onboarding.md) or role-specific guides
3. **Learn Your Responsibilities**: Follow the governance guides specific to your role (architecture, development, review, AI, finance)
4. **Apply in PRs**: Use the governance checklist in every PR to verify compliance before submission

## Reporting Issues

If you find a governance violation or have questions about governance:
1. Create a GitHub issue using the [governance-violation template](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/governance-violation.md)
2. Document which principle is affected and the severity
3. Include evidence and proposed corrective actions
